title: BAF60C links nucleolar stress to β cell dysfunction in type 2 diabetes through controlling Reg3b mRNA decay
authors: Zhuoying Yang, Shuaishuai Zhu, Cheng-An Lyu, Hongxing Fu, Wei Chen, Xinyuan Qiu, Wenjing Zhang, Ting Yu, Miqi Yang, Zhe Yu Zhang, Qiyao Xu, Xiao Z. Shen, Peter van Endert, Sheng Yan, Zhuo-Xian Meng
abstract: Yang et al. reveal that β cells actively shape the islet immune microenvironment through BAF60C. By forming an RNA-protein complex that stabilizes Reg3b mRNA, BAF60C suppresses pro-inflammatory macrophage activation, linking nucleolar stress to β cell dysfunction in type 2 diabetes.

title: Unleashing T cell surveillance for the eradication of quiescent persister tumor cells resistant to neoadjuvant chemotherapy

title: Disruption of WNT/Notch signaling in pancreatic cancer reveals tumors depend on the intricate equilibrium of malignant cell states
authors: Stefan R. Torborg, Jung Yun Kim, Anupriya Singhal, Olivera Grbovic-Huezo, Matilda Holm, Katherine Wu, Xuexiang Han, Yu-Jui Ho, Caj Haglund, Michael J. Mitchell, Scott W. Lowe, Lukas E. Dow, Kenneth L. Pitter, Francisco J. Sanchez-Rivera, Andre Levchenko, Tuomas Tammela

title: Hematopoietic stem cells activate a latent differentiation pathway to facilitate recovery after 5-fluorouracil-induced myeloablation
authors: Zhen Zhang, Ben Jin, Chenyu You, Ya Li, Li Lin, Jianlong Sun
abstract: Zhang et al. demonstrate that 5-FU-induced myeloablation in mice triggers two waves of hematopoietic stem cell differentiation and replenishes multipotent progenitor subsets with diverse lineage potentials.

title: Host-transposon mutualism supports regeneration in planarians
authors: Hae-Lim Lee, Axel Poulet, Sudheesh Allikka Parambil, Josien C. van Wolfswinkel
abstract: Lee et al. find that the planarian transposon Burro1 bolsters stem cell resilience by producing a functional host-derived caspase inhibitor during physiological stress. By suppressing apoptosis, active Burro1 elements enhance the regenerative capacity of planarians and have sustained this mutualisti…

title: Desmosomes compartmentalize mRNA and translation in the skin
authors: Alec D’Alessandro, Kwabena Badu-Nkansah, Sophia Link, Daniel Hlavaty, Glenn Bjerke, Christopher V. Nicchitta, Rui Yi, Terry Lechler
abstract: D’Alessandro et al. reveal that skin cells compartmentalize translation at their cortex in a desmosome-dependent manner. Wounds induce translational changes linking cell adhesion to adaptive translation.

title: CircRNA-encoded RIPK1-98 protein drives lung adenocarcinoma progression
authors: Qi Sun, Runqiu Chi, Xiao Zhang, Tianxiang Chen, Xin Xu, Lifang Ma, Xiaoting Tian, Yayou Miao, Yongchun Yu, Rui Kang, Guido Kroemer, Yi Shi, Daolin Tang, Jiayi Wang
abstract: Sun et al. employed integrated multi-omics approaches to identify novel circRNA-encoded proteins, particularly RIPK1-98 in LUAD. RIPK1-98 promotes CDK2-mediated cell-cycle regulation, highlighting its potential as a biomarker and therapeutic target for LUAD progression.
